newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq violates U.N. air embargo by flying 104 Moslem pilgrims to Jeddah airport.
- Lebanon, Qatar sign memorandum of understanding to boost agricultural cooperation.
- Yemen, Japan to discuss rescheduling debts worth $150 million.
- National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia reports a 77.6 million riyal loss in 1996.
- Bahrain-Qatar territorial dispute remains unresolved, Bahrain foreign minister says.
- Saudi Interior minister urges Iranian Moslem pilgrims to respect Saudi Arabia's security.
- Germany's Commerzbank to invest $100 million in Morocco bank.
- Qatar Airways gets $20 million from government to expand its fleet and operations.
